correctness.rationale: Descent lemma gives alpha−(L/(2b))alpha² per block. Rayleigh bounds on symmetric B imply alpha in [min(1,b/M),1], and this concave quadratic is minimized at an interval endpoint. Scalar objective Lz²/2+z with B=0 or B=M realizes both endpoints, proving optimality for all positive L,M,b. Solving both inequalities Gamma>=1/4 yields stated continuous threshold at L=M/2, including region L>=3M/2 where b*>=M. Two-agent consensus model has first-coordinate curvature L−delta/2−epsilon→L and preserves connectedness. Independently checked 1254 exact-rational (L,M,b) trials with endpoint, threshold and Rayleigh cases; finite checks support but do not prove universal claim.
